transition: 2 of the rung — the known-positive control
name: bench-instrument-detection-curve
written_before: Any slowdown-injection code exists, and before any arm has been run. Transition 1 (the no-op control) is already MEASURED and is the baseline below. These predictions are recorded so the detection curve cannot be read backwards into whatever threshold the results happen to permit.

what_transition_1_measured.design: sequential base->head, both arms one macos-14 runner, base==head (true no-op)
what_transition_1_measured.result: FAILED. 25 cells compared: 13 regressed, 10 improved, 2 within noise.
what_transition_1_measured.sign_distribution: 15 of 25 head-slower (60%), 10 head-faster (40%); median of medians +8.46%, mean +3.77%
what_transition_1_measured.mechanism: Order/thermal bias is real but MINOR (~+8% lean). The dominant term is bidirectional variance reaching +/-60%.
what_transition_1_measured.structural_cause: 37 of 43 benched cells run at criterion sample_size(20); detection fires at criterion's default noise_threshold of 1%. Twenty samples cannot resolve a 1% effect.

what_transition_1_retired: Cross-runner comparison is NOT the whole story: a dedicated runner on identical code produced MORE spurious regressions (13) than a contended local box in the same shape (9).
Sequential base->head is falsified as a fine-grained grading design, on magnitude rather than on systematic direction.
Order-balanced blocks (B H | H B) are demoted: they attack the ~8% ordering term and leave the ~60% variance intact. Not the next move.

the_transition.claim_boundary: This transition establishes what effect sizes this benchmark family can DETECT on the LARQL macos-14 runner. It does not build a gate, does not merge one, and does not tune any threshold.
the_transition.success: A detection curve exists for four workload classes at four predeclared effect sizes, measured against arms fixed before any of them ran.
the_transition.non_claim: Nothing here establishes that a detected slowdown was CAUSED by a change under review. Detection capability and causal attribution are separate claims; only the first is at stake.
the_transition.objective_change: PERF-QUAL supersedes #370's original objective. #370 asked for a reliable fine-grained regression gate. Transition 1 showed this surface cannot support one at 1%. The objective is now a QUALIFIED CATASTROPHIC GUARDRAIL plus an empirical statement of resolution.

the_predeclared_arms.rule: All four arms are declared here and run as a set. The detector is NOT tuned after seeing any individual arm. If an arm surprises, that is a result, not an invitation to adjust the next arm.
the_predeclared_arms.injection: A deterministic work multiplier applied to the HEAD arm only, via a dispatch input. Base and head remain the SAME COMMIT, so the only difference between arms is the injected work — the no-op machinery from transition 1 with one term added.

the_statistic_under_test.decision_variable: The CI LOWER BOUND of the change, never the median alone.
the_statistic_under_test.why: Transition 1's worst spurious cell had median +59.69% but lower bound +43.65%. The lower bound is the conservative end and is what a guardrail should be built on; using the median would import ~16 points of optimism at exactly the wrong moment.
the_statistic_under_test.why_100: The failure this gate exists for is the q4_matvec_v4 row-drop, an approximately 4x throughput cliff. The task is preventing an architectural accident, not distinguishing 4.8ms from 5.0ms. +100% also sits far above the +43.65% maximum lower bound observed on identical code, so the daylight is measured rather than assumed.

predictions.note: Stated as falsifiable expectations. Being wrong is the useful outcome; these exist so that cannot be quietly re-narrated afterwards.

P1_noop_under_catastrophe_criterion.prediction: The transition-1 no-op data produces ZERO cells with lower_bound > +100%. Max observed was +43.65%.
P1_noop_under_catastrophe_criterion.falsified_if: Any identical-code cell reaches a lower bound above 100%. That would kill the +100% guardrail outright, not merely shift it.

P2_A25_is_NOT_reliably_detected.prediction: At +25% injection, fewer than half of cells show lower_bound > +25%. The no-op noise floor already reaches +43.65%, so a 25% signal is inside the noise for this instrument.
P2_A25_is_NOT_reliably_detected.falsified_if: A25 is detected in most cells, which would mean the instrument is far better than transition 1 implied and the whole variance diagnosis needs revisiting.

P3_A50_is_partial.prediction: At +50%, detection is real but incomplete and CLASS-DEPENDENT — I expect the long decomposition cells to do better than metal decode, because the worst transition-1 offenders were the small fast decode cells.
P3_A50_is_partial.falsified_if: Detection is uniform across classes, which would say the variance is not workload-class-structured and sample count alone explains everything.

P4_A100_mostly_detected.prediction: At +100%, most cells exceed a +50% lower bound, but NOT all exceed +100%. I expect the +100% criterion to be marginal at exactly +100% injection.
P4_A100_mostly_detected.falsified_if: A100 fires the +100% criterion in essentially every cell — that would mean the guardrail could be set materially lower than 100%.

P5_A300_is_caught_everywhere.prediction: At +300%, every class fires lower_bound > +100%. This is the arm the guardrail exists to catch.
P5_A300_is_caught_everywhere.falsified_if: ANY class fails to fire at +300%. That falsifies the catastrophic-guardrail concept itself for this surface, and PERF-SAFETY should not then be merged.

P6_the_separation_exists.prediction: There is a threshold T with no-op(max lower bound) < T < A300(min lower bound) — i.e. the instrument can separate catastrophe from silence even though it cannot separate 25% from silence.
P6_the_separation_exists.falsified_if: No such T exists. That is the single most important thing this transition can discover, and it would mean the surface supports no blocking perf gate at any threshold.

acceptance_before_anything_merges.PERF_SAFETY_blocking: fail only when lower_bound > catastrophe threshold, the threshold chosen from THIS curve and never below the observed no-op maximum plus margin
acceptance_before_anything_merges.PERF_SIGNAL_informational: report +10/+20/+50% movements as telemetry, never block, because the instrument has not demonstrated it can adjudicate them in one invocation
qualification_is_a_precondition_not_a_re: noop must produce ZERO hard-gate failures
the known-positive catastrophe arm must FAIL the hard gate
both must be re-run and still hold after any substantial change to the gate

the_doctrine_this_rung_is_really_about: A benchmark is not automatically a measuring instrument merely because it emits confidence intervals. Its discrimination threshold has to be qualified before its verdicts are given authority. Authority proportional to demonstrated resolution — the same rule the rest of the estate already applies to oracles and conformance readers.
